purpose: Freeze of the proposed doppler.routing-aware-acceptance/v1 limits for one fresh unforced test (owner direction 2026-11-12). This is not an approval: approval.status, nearTie.status and taskQuality.status stay "proposed", nothing is released, Flash-Next stays BLOCKED, and doppler.boundary-tolerance/quantized-v1 stays the strict gate.
consistencyReview: Every proposed value is used as-is. No rule was found internally inconsistent, so nothing was changed before freezing.
evaluatorNotes: The evaluator returns fail with POLICY_NOT_APPROVED for any proposed policy; the report lists every other reason and each criterion separately.
approval.approvedAtUtc is null, so the evaluator cannot check freshness; every fresh run must start after frozenAtUtc, which the report checks against run-starts.jsonl.

preregisteredChoices.runtime: profiles/flash-next-routed-f32kv-qualification resolved with applyRuntimeProfile (no inline execution graph) for every GPU run
preregisteredChoices.sameInputCase: the pinned long-context case with the fewest frozen tokens (ties: lowest id); positions = the prompt set samplePositions for that case
preregisteredChoices.finalNormFamily: Flash-Next replaces the final RMSNorm with the root hyper-connection mixer; the final-norm family checks that mixer (norm and mixed output)
preregisteredChoices.greedyStop: manifest eos_token_id; CPU and GPU continuations are truncated after the first stop token before comparison
preregisteredChoices.cpuGreedy: cache-free re-run of the pinned producer on prompt + the CPU's own earlier greedy tokens; never reads GPU output
preregisteredChoices.klComputation: float64 log-softmax of complete CPU and GPU logit rows; cpuTop1MarginLogits = CPU top-1 minus top-2 logit
preregisteredChoices.tupleDevice: vendor and architecture from the WebGPU adapter info, architecture with hyphens removed (rdna-3 -> rdna3); adapter = "vendor | architecture | device | description"
preregisteredChoices.observationNeutrality: unforced observe-run prefill logits vs the plain tests/integration/flash-next-learned-physical.test.js run (no routing or stage hooks)
preregisteredChoices.routingControls: observe and forced-indices runs for all cases share one model load (run-routing-controls.js)

runsBeforeFreeze: No pinned prompt has been tokenized or run. Harness smoke runs used only the retained non-pinned marbles and inventory prompts.
